answer: Audits are written down in summit, queued in pulse, and raven publishes the wait time. A farm of 328 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 82 identities per epoch. A farm of 4125 identities would post 1918 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
